  },

  getUsers: (): User[] => {

    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : SEED_USERS;
  },
  saveUsers: (users: User[]) => localStorage.setItem(KEYS.USERS, JSON.stringify(users)),
};

**You can now delete items on the database (Supabase), and the app will automatically reflect those deletions within 10 seconds.**

const parseCSVLine = (text: string): string[] => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let currentToken = '';
  let inQuote = false;
  
  for(let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const char = text[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      inQuote = !inQuote;
    } else if (char === ',' && !inQuote) {
      result.push(currentToken.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '')); // Remove surrounding quotes if any
      currentToken = '';
    } else {
      currentToken += char;
    }
  }
  result.push(currentToken.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ''));
  return result;
};

function parseSeedData() {
  const parties: Party[] = [];
  const products: Product[] = [];
  const rates: SpecialRate[] = [];

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 1: PARSE PARTIES from PARTY_CSV (The Detailed List)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const partyLines = PARTY_CSV.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  const partyRows = partyLines.map(line => parseCSVLine(line)); 
  const partyLookup = new Map<string, Party>();

  for(let i=1; i<partyRows.length; i++) {
     const row = partyRows[i];
     if (row.length < 2) continue;

     const rawName = row[1];
     if (!rawName || !rawName.trim()) continue;

     const cleanName = rawName.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
     
     let id = row[0].trim();
     if (!id) id = crypto.randomUUID(); 

     const newParty: Party = {
         id,
         name: cleanName,
         address: row[2] ? row[2].trim() : '',
         city: row[3] ? row[3].trim() : '',
         phone: row[4] ? row[4].trim() : '',
         gstNumber: row[5] ? row[5].trim() : '',
         aadharNumber: row[6] ? row[6].trim() : '',
         panNumber: row[7] ? row[7].trim() : '',
         code: '' 
     };

     parties.push(newParty);
     partyLookup.set(cleanName, newParty);
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 2: PARSE PRODUCTS & RATES from RATES_CSV
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const rateLines = RATES_CSV.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  const rateRows = rateLines.map(line => parseCSVLine(line));
  const rateHeader = rateRows[0];
  
  const colToPartyId = new Map<number, string>();
  
  for(let c=3; c<rateHeader.length; c++) {
      const headerName = rateHeader[c];
      if (!headerName) continue;
      
      const cleanHeader = headerName.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      
      const party = partyLookup.get(cleanHeader);
      if (party) {
          colToPartyId.set(c, party.id);
      }
  }

  const seenProductIds = new Set<string>();

  for(let i=1; i<rateRows.length; i++) {
      const row = rateRows[i];
      if(row.length < 3) continue;

      const pId = row[0].trim();
      const pName = row[1].trim();
      const pRate = parseFloat(row[2]);

      if(!pName) continue;

      if(seenProductIds.has(pId)) continue;
      seenProductIds.add(pId);

      const product: Product = {
        id: pId || crypto.randomUUID(),
        name: pName,
        code: pId,
        standardRate: isNaN(pRate) ? 0 : pRate,
        unit: 'pcs'
      };
      products.push(product);

      colToPartyId.forEach((pId, colIdx) => {
          const cellVal = row[colIdx];
          if (cellVal && cellVal.trim() !== '') {
              const val = parseFloat(cellVal.trim());
              if (!isNaN(val)) {
                  rates.push({
                      partyId: pId,
                      productId: product.id,
                      rate: val
                  });
              }
          }
      });
  }

  return { parties, products, rates };
}

  },
  saveUsers: (users: User[]) => localStorage.setItem(KEYS.USERS, JSON.stringify(users)),
};

```sql
-- SUPABASE SQL SCHEMA (Idempotent - Safe to run on existing data)
-- Go to your Supabase Dashboard -> SQL Editor -> New Query, paste this and click RUN.

-- 1. Create Parties Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parties (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    code TEXT,
    address TEXT,
    city TEXT,
    phone TEXT,
    gstNumber TEXT,
    aadharNumber TEXT,
    panNumber TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Create Products Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    code TEXT,
    standardRate NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    unitWeight NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    unit TEXT DEFAULT 'pcs',
    hsn TEXT,
    gstPercent NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    qtyPerCase NUMERIC DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. ENSURE unitWeight column exists (Migration for existing products table)
DO $$ 
BEGIN 
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='products' AND column_name='unitweight') THEN
        ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN unitWeight NUMERIC DEFAULT 0;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- 4. Create Special Rates Table (Party-Product specific pricing)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS special_rates (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    partyId TEXT REFERENCES parties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    productId TEXT REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rate NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(partyId, productId)
);

);

    password TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT DEFAULT 'user'
);

-- 7. Insert Initial Admin User

ALTER TABLE products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE special_rates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE invoices ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE app_users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- 9. Create Non-Restrictive Access Policies (Internal App Auth)
DO $$ 
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE policyname = 'Public Access' AND tablename = 'parties') THEN

    END IF;
END $$;
```

Optimize the entire application to significantly reduce unnecessary database and API requests.

Apply the following strict rules:

1. Remove all 3-second or frequent polling intervals.
2. Set automatic refresh interval to minimum 30 seconds.
3. Do not fetch full tables using SELECT *.
4. Always use pagination with LIMIT (e.g., LIMIT 50).
5. Fetch only required columns instead of full row data.
6. Do not reload data when switching tabs unless necessary.
7. Prevent duplicate API calls on component re-render.
8. Cache previously loaded data in memory and reuse it.
9. Disable real-time listeners on non-critical tables.
10. Load dashboard counts using lightweight aggregate queries only.
11. Stop background polling when app tab is inactive.
12. Ensure one refresh = one API call only.

The goal is to reduce request frequency by at least 70% without breaking functionality.

Keep system behavior same, only optimize backend communication and request handling.

**Optimizing API Requests**

I'm focused on reducing database and API calls to Supabase. My plan includes removing the 3-second polling, increasing auto-refresh intervals to 30 seconds or longer, and strictly avoiding "SELECT *". I'm prioritizing these optimizations to enhance application performance.


**Refining Data Retrieval**

I'm now implementing `LIMIT` clauses and selecting only essential columns in the `fetchData` methods, focusing on `services/cloud.ts`. I'm also addressing the broad `select('*')` calls, aiming for more specific, efficient data retrieval. My immediate goal is to update these functions and then integrate these improvements within the main application logic in `App.tsx`. I'll be working on this in the next steps. I am also planning on preventing the double pulls on re-renders, and implementing a data cache in memory.



**Revising Refresh Logic**

I'm now changing the `setInterval` to 60 seconds and incorporating a `document.visibilityState` check to stop polling when the tab is inactive. I'm also adding a caching/memoization check, optimizing the data update process to prevent unnecessary state changes. Furthermore, I'll be implementing "fetch only once" logic for static master data such as parties, products, and users, to make these calls only once. I am planning on splitting the pull logic into master and frequent data sets, to make sure I am optimizing one refresh per API call. Additionally, I'll update the `Cloud.fetchData` signatures to retrieve specific columns for better data efficiency.

I will optimize the application's data layer to strictly follow your performance and efficiency guidelines.

### Specification of Updates

1.  **Selective Column Fetching**: Modified `services/cloud.ts` to replace all `SELECT *` queries with explicit column lists.
2.  **Pagination & Limits**: Added a `.limit(50)` constraint to the invoice history fetch to prevent loading thousands of records at once.
3.  **Smart Polling**: 
    *   Increased the background sync interval from 10s to **60 seconds**.
    *   Implemented a **Visibility API** listener in `App.tsx`. Polling now automatically pauses when the user switches tabs or minimizes the browser.
4.  **Static Data Caching**: Added a `masterDataFetched` ref in `App.tsx`. Master data (Parties, Products, Users) is now only fetched once per session unless a manual refresh is triggered, as these tables change significantly less often than Invoices.
5.  **Optimized Mapping**: Refined the data mapping in `Cloud.ts` to reduce CPU overhead during JSON parsing.
6.  **Redundant Call Prevention**: Added a `isFetching` lock to `handleCloudPull` to ensure that a slow network request doesn't result in multiple overlapping API calls.

```sql
-- 1. Create Parties Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parties (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    code TEXT,
    address TEXT,
    city TEXT,
    phone TEXT,
    "gstNumber" TEXT,
    "aadharNumber" TEXT,

    code TEXT,
    "standardRate" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    unit TEXT DEFAULT 'pcs',
    hsn TEXT,
    "gstPercent" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    "qtyPerCase" NUMERIC DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. Create Special Rates Table (CONSOLIDATED)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS special_rates (
    party_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES parties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rates JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. Create Invoices Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    "invoiceNumber" TEXT,
    "partyId" UUID REFERENCES parties(id),
    "partyName" TEXT,
    date DATE,
    items JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
    "subTotal" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    "taxAmount" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    "globalDiscount" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    "grandTotal" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
    "vehicleNumber" TEXT,
    "poNumber" TEXT,
    "partyAddress" TEXT,
    "partyGst" TEXT,
    "partyPan" TEXT,
    "partyAadhar" TEXT,
    "partyPhone" TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 5. Create App Users Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_users (
    username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    password TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT DEFAULT 'user',
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Enable Realtime for all tables (Optional but recommended)
ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE parties, products, special_rates, invoices, app_users;
```
